source_row.rationale: Metoclopramide acts as a prokinetic agent, increasing the rate of gastric emptying and upper GI motility, in addition to its antiemetic effects (largely through central dopamine receptor blockade), making it useful for conditions involving delayed gastric emptying (such as gastroparesis) in addition to nausea/vomiting management.
source_row.source_detail: Prokinetic and Antiemetic Mechanisms of Action
